# Casa Mia Tours

> > Casa Mia Tours offers authentic Italian culinary experiences, food tours, and cultural insights across Italy's regions from Sicily to Piemonte.

Founded by Eleonora and Carolyn, Casa Mia Tours specializes in immersive Italian food and wine experiences, featuring local producers, traditional recipes, and seasonal cooking traditions. The site showcases regional Italian cuisine, restaurant recommendations, and personal stories from artisans and winemakers across Tuscany, Sicily, Amalfi Coast, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Italian cuisine and regional cooking
- Seasonal produce and traditional recipes
- Italian winemakers and food artisans
- Tuscany, Sicily, and Piemonte culinary traditions
- Florence, Rome, and Amalfi Coast dining
- Italian herbs and herb gardens
- Salumi and Italian charcuterie
- Restaurant reviews and dining recommendations
- Culinary tours and food experiences
- Italian food culture and heritage
- Seasonal cooking and harvest guides
- Italian street food and comfort dishes
- Local producers and family recipes

## Regional Italian Cuisine & Seasonal Cooking

- [10 Italian Winter Dishes](https://casamiatours.com/10-italian-winter-dishes): Bucket list of Italian winter comfort foods: polenta, ribollita, cassoeula
- [What fruit and vegetables are in season in October in Italy](https://casamiatours.com/what-fruit-and-vegetables-are-in-season-in-october-in-italy): Monthly guide to seasonal produce in Italy: October harvest vegetables
- [The foods of Cilento](https://casamiatours.com/foods-of-cilento): Photo essay of Cilento cuisine: seafood, anchovies, white figs
- [Nonna's Piemonte Recipes](https://casamiatours.com/nonnas-piemonte-recipes): Family heritage: Nonna Titta's traditional Piemonte recipes from Asti
- [Anguria - A Summer Gift to Beat the Heat](https://casamiatours.com/anguria-a-gift-in-the-midst-of-summer-heat): Watermelon (anguria) recipes and summer refreshment in Italian cuisine

## Restaurant Reviews & Dining Guides

- [Trattoria Sergio Gozzi in Florence](https://casamiatours.com/trattoria-sergio-gozzi-in-florence): Florence restaurant review: Trattoria Sergio Gozzi with peposo recipe
- [Alberobello dining tip: EVO Ristorante](https://casamiatours.com/alberobello-evo-ristorante): Restaurant review: EVO Ristorante in Alberobello, Puglia
- [The beaches of Positano](https://casamiatours.com/the-beaches-of-positano): Beach guide to Positano on the Amalfi Coast

## Our Italians: Local Producers & Artisans

- [Our Italians: Giuseppe and Valeria of Vini Scirto](https://casamiatours.com/vini-scirto): Our Italians series: interview with Etna winemakers Giuseppe & Valeria
- [Our Italians: Debora De Marco of Gourmet B&B Villa Landucci](https://casamiatours.com/our-italians-debora-de-marco): Our Italians series: Debora De Marco of Villa Landucci B&B in Florence

## Traditional Recipes & Italian Specialties

- [I Ham what I Ham: Parte 6 – Sopressa](https://casamiatours.com/i-ham-what-i-ham-sopressa): Italian salumi series: Sopressa salami from Veneto region
- [Scabbardfish Involtini Recipe](https://casamiatours.com/scabbardfish-involtini-recipe): Sicilian seafood recipe: scabbardfish involtini from Ortigia market
- [Acceddu cu l'ova, Sicilian Easter Biscotti](https://casamiatours.com/acceddu-cu-lova-sicilys-easter-biscotti): Sicilian Easter biscotti recipe and tradition: acceddu cu l'ova
- [Pizza di Patate](https://casamiatours.com/pizza-di-patate): Rome street food spotlight: pizza di patate (potato pizza)
- [Table dreams, Time and a Recipe](https://casamiatours.com/table-dreams-time-and-a-recipe): Personal reflection on friendship and gathering with lemon chicken recipe

## Italian Herbs & Ingredients

- [The Herb Garden: Parsley](https://casamiatours.com/herb-garden-parsley): Herb Garden series: exploring parsley history and use in Italian cuisine
- [Food to get you in the mood: Italian aphrodisiacs](https://casamiatours.com/aphrodisiacs): Italian aphrodisiac foods and romantic dining ingredients from the pantry
